import subprocess, sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.find_spec('openpyxl')
print('openpyxl spec:', spec)
if spec is None:
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'openpyxl', '-q'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    print('pip returncode:', r.returncode)
    print('stdout:', r.stdout[-2000:])
    print('stderr:', r.stderr[-2000:])
import importlib
try:
    m = importlib.import_module('openpyxl')
    print('openpyxl version:', m.__version__)
except Exception as e:
    print('import failed:', e)

import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8'))
print('=========== STYLES ===========')
print(z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8'))

import zipfile, os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    data = {n: z.read(n) for n in names}

sheet = data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = data['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

def rep(s, old, new, tag):
    assert s.count(old) == 1, f"{tag}: pattern not found exactly once: {old[:100]}"
    return s.replace(old, new)

# 1) Extend dimension to include column H
sheet = rep(sheet, 'dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"', 'dimension')

# 2) Add column width for column 8
sheet = rep(sheet,
            '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
            '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>',
            'cols')

# 3) Header cell H1
sheet = rep(sheet,
            '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
            '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin (%)</t></is></c></row>',
            'header H1')

# 4) Data rows 2-9: margin formula =G/E
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old.replace('</row>', f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>')
    sheet = rep(sheet, old, new, f'row {r}')

# 5) Total row 10: aggregate margin =G10/E10
sheet = rep(sheet,
            '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>',
            '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c><c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>',
            'row 10')

# 6) styles.xml: add custom percentage format 0.0% (numFmtId 164) and a new cellXf (index 3)
styles = rep(styles, '<numFmts count="0"/>',
             '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>', 'numFmts')
styles = rep(styles, '<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">', 'cellXfs count')
styles = rep(styles, '</cellXfs>',
             '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>',
             'cellXfs entry')

data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
data['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for n in names:
        z.writestr(n, data[n])

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('modified OK')
